description: Declared composition of the Universal Measurement Policy Framework. WHICH measurements bind to a Foundation determination, and HOW strongly each one binds, is declared here rather than fixed in code (UFC-04). A project that must not be blocked by a measurement sets its 'blocking' to false in its own copy of this document; it never edits a policy class. Precedence orders evaluation and reporting deterministically — highest first, never insertion order (UFC-05). Adding a shipped policy to a project is an entry here; adding a NEW policy is a registered MeasurementPolicy, and neither requires editing the engine.

policies.$rationale: An unclassified locator means the Truth policy does not yet cover the population. Blocking: a determination over unclassified Truth is not a determination.
Every subject SHALL carry exactly one declared canonical owner (CEP-002 Art 14). Blocking.
The named residue of undeclared ownership. Blocking, so the gate reports WHICH determination is incomplete rather than one opaque percentage.

Partitions the blocking residue rather than re-blocking it: the share whose absence names a located eligibility deficit needs an ACT (register the artifact, give it the declared form, move it out of derived residue), while the remainder is the honest governance floor. Non-blocking for the same reason as EvidenceOnlySourcePolicy — the disclosure IS the required behaviour, and blocking here would double-count a block UnresolvedOwnershipPolicy already declares.
An unsettled contest is an undecidable precedence and is never broken by a tiebreaker. Blocking.
Every admitted source SHALL reach a declared canonical destination. Blocking.
Evidence admitted but never homed is a reported gap, not a closure failure: evidence proves and does not own, so its presence without a home is a legitimate steady state.
A source no adapter can normalise is disclosed rather than silently dropped. Non-blocking: the honest report IS the required behaviour, and blocking here would punish disclosure.
The composite closure determination over every other measurement. Blocking, evaluated last.
